meta.name: who-decides
meta.description: Map stakeholders, decision rights, influence and blockers from supplied evidence. Use when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理相关方权责,标出谁拍板、谁影响、谁可能挡路,让决策不再悬空
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队里没人说得清某件事到底该谁拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Map who decides, who influences, and who can block, so stalled calls get unstuck
copy.fit_line_en: For you if no one can say who owns the final call.

howto.what: 根据你提供的材料,梳理出相关方是谁、谁有决策权、谁有影响力、谁可能阻挠。产出基于所给证据的权责地图,并保留仍未确定的信息。
howto.when: 当权责归属不清晰,或利益相关方格局发生变化时触发。被 @fde 调用时,沿用它现有的脱敏材料与范围。

say.text: 根据这份材料,梳理一下利益相关方和决策权归属
say.note: 输出谁拍板、谁有影响力

say.text: 这次变动后,谁可能阻挠?还没定的部分标出来
say.note: 区分影响力和阻碍者,保留未知项

say.text: 帮我区分实施、验证、上线和验收分别由谁负责
say.note: 按材料标注各环节权责

howto.what_en: From the evidence you supply, it maps who the stakeholders are, who holds decision rights, who has influence and who may block. It outputs a rights map based only on that evidence, keeping unknowns open.
howto.when_en: Triggers when ownership is unclear or the stakeholder landscape changes. When called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Map the stakeholders and decision rights from this material
say_en.note: Shows who decides and who holds influence

say_en.text: After this change, who might block it? Mark what's undecided
say_en.note: Separates influence from blockers, keeps unknowns

say_en.text: Show who owns implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance
say_en.note: Labels rights per stage from your material
